flagged.location: ## Definition, encoder equation (line 40) and decoder residual description (line 42)
flagged.evidence: Line 40 adds MHA(X,X,X) to X, and line 42 adds each decoder attention output to a width-d residual input. The dependency def-multihead-self-attention (lines 27, 36) permits arbitrary positive output width d_o and gives MHA output shape R^{n_q×d_o}. Without requiring d_o=d for encoder self-attention, decoder self-attention, and decoder cross-attention, these additions are undefined when d_o≠d.

The Definition gives X∈R^{n×d} and decoder inputs U∈R^{m×d}, E∈R^{n×d} without requiring n,m≥1. The dependency def-multihead-self-attention (line 27) requires n_q,n_k to be positive integers. Zero-row inputs therefore fall outside the stated MHA domain; require positive sequence lengths.
